_comment: Collector settings. Edit here, not in code. Read once at startup, so a change needs a collector redeploy. Any key you leave out falls back to the built-in default in server/collector-service.mjs, so a partial file is fine.

aisstream._comment: Primary feed. One websocket, server pushes to us, no per-message cost. Key in env AISSTREAM_API_KEY.

vesselapi._comment: Secondary feed. REST, ONE CALL PER SHIP, metered. Key in env VESSELAPI_KEY. pollingMode: 'fallback' = only while aisstream is starved | 'parallel' = always, on its own interval, alongside aisstream | 'off' = never call it.

history._comment: Thinning gates for the `tracks` collection: a berthed ship transmits every 3 min and most of that is GPS jitter. Every gate fails OPEN (stores the fix).
